question: Suppose $S$ is the set of all positive integers. For $a,b\in S$, define $$a*b=\frac{\operatorname{lcm}(a,b)}{\operatorname{g.c.d.}(a,b)}.$$ For example, $8*12=6$. Show that exactly two of the following three properties are satisfied: (i) if $a,b\in S$ then $a*b\in S$; (ii) $(a*b)*c=a*(b*c)$ for all $a,b,c\in S$; (iii) There exists an element $i\in S$ such that $a*i=a$ for all $a\in S$.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
